info.title: TPJP API
info.description: Lotte India Telecalling Permanent Journey Plan — dashboard API. Every response uses the envelope { success, message, data, meta } or, on failure, { success: false, code, message, errors }.

accessToken.description: Short-lived bearer token. Keep in memory only.

mustChangePassword.description: Signed in with a temporary password: every other endpoint answers 403 PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED until it is changed.

refreshToken.description: Keep in encrypted storage; send to /app/auth/refresh.

verified.description: Step 1 done: the new number entered its code.

approved.description: Step 2 done: the Primary Contact entered theirs.

reportsToUserId.description: The manager one level up (ASM→RM→ZM→GM). Null for GM and ADMIN.

password.description: Temporary password; the user must change it at first sign-in.

reportsToUserId.description: The manager one level up (ASM→RM→ZM→GM). Null for GM and ADMIN.

post.summary: Sign in with username and password
post.description: Sets the refresh token as an httpOnly cookie (tpjp_rt, SameSite=Strict, path /api/v1/auth). The same message is returned for an unknown username and a wrong password.

401.description: Not signed in or token expired

post.summary: Get a new access token using the refresh cookie
post.description: Sets the refresh token as an httpOnly cookie (tpjp_rt, SameSite=Strict, path /api/v1/auth). Rotates the refresh token; reusing an old one ends every session of that user (REFRESH_REUSED).

401.description: Not signed in or token expired

post.summary: Sign out: revoke the session and clear the refresh cookie

401.description: Not signed in or token expired

post.description: Sets the refresh token as an httpOnly cookie (tpjp_rt, SameSite=Strict, path /api/v1/auth). Ends every session of the user and returns a fresh one for this device.

401.description: Not signed in or token expired

post.summary: Text a password reset code to the registered mobile
post.description: The same answer whether or not the username and mobile match an account, so it cannot be used to find accounts.

post.summary: Set a new password with the texted code
post.description: Ends every session of the user; they sign in with the new password.

post.summary: Text a sign-in code to a registered telecaller number
post.description: The same answer whether or not the number is registered and active, so it cannot be used to find numbers.

post.summary: Sign in with the texted code

post.description: Rotates the refresh token; reusing an old one ends every app session of that number (REFRESH_REUSED).

401.description: Not signed in or token expired

post.summary: Sign out: revoke the session named by the refresh token

401.description: Not signed in or token expired

get.summary: The distributor's telecaller numbers (Primary Contact only)

401.description: Not signed in or token expired

post.summary: Add a number: texts a code to it and a code to the Primary Contact
post.description: The number stays PENDING until both codes are entered (/verify and /approve). Sending one of this distributor's PENDING or INACTIVE numbers again restarts its verification and resends both codes.

401.description: Not signed in or token expired

post.summary: Step 1: the code texted to the new number
post.description: The number turns ACTIVE once both steps are done, in either order.

401.description: Not signed in or token expired

post.summary: Step 2: the code texted to the Primary Contact's own number
post.description: The number turns ACTIVE once both steps are done, in either order.

patch.description: The number itself cannot be edited: add the new number and deactivate the old one.
